arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats

df = pd.read_csv('data/housing_dataset.csv')
mainroad_prices = df[df['mainroad'] == 'yes']['price']
not_mainroad_prices = df[df['mainroad'] == 'no']['price']

t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(mainroad_prices, not_mainroad_prices)
print(f'p_value: {p_val:.4f}')
"
